meta.field_note: Each entry retains signature, parameter names/flags/defaults, keywords, version history, platform support and the vendor URL. Prose and examples are not copied; see the URL.

compatibility_interpretation.ios: Inherited upstream flag; not FileMaker Go support. Go cannot load external plug-ins. iOS App SDK apps require a separately verified compatible plug-in build.
compatibility_interpretation.fms: Inherited FileMaker Server flag; verify function, OS, build and FMSE permissions. It does not certify WPE/WebDirect support. PSoS executes on the server, not the requesting client.
compatibility_interpretation.webdirect: Compatible plug-ins execute in the server WPE, not in the browser; install and enable them for that engine.

Arrays.notes: 1-based indexing throughout. BE_ArrayFind returns -1 if not found.

Clipboard.notes: BE_ClipboardFormats returns a value list of available formats. Widely used with ProofKit / agentic-fm for fmxmlsnippet clipboard operations.

Error Checking.notes: Always check BE_GetLastError immediately after every HTTP/FTP/SMTP call — it resets on the next call. BE_CurlTrace is expensive; use only when standard error checks are insufficient.

version_history.change: Changed the way this works so that successive calls to the BE_GetLastError function don't reset the value that is returned, it's only reset when performing any other function call.

Files and Folders.notes: All paths are native OS paths (POSIX on Mac/Linux, backslash on Windows). Do NOT use FileMaker Get() paths directly — strip the 'file:/' prefix first. BE_FileListFolder returns file names only, not full paths.

HTTP and URLs.notes: Headers set with BE_HTTP_SetCustomHeader persist across all subsequent HTTP calls until cleared or overwritten. Always check BE_GetLastError and BE_HTTP_ResponseCode immediately after each call — they reset on the next call. Calling BE_CurlSetOption with no parameters resets all curl options to defaults.

Time.notes: All return integers. BE_TimeZoneOffset returns local UTC offset in minutes.

Value Lists.notes: All operate on FileMaker value lists (newline-delimited). BE_ValuesSort type: 0 = text, 1 = numeric; order: 0 = ascending, 1 = descending.

version_history.change: Added the ascending and type parameters

Vectors.notes: Vectors are FileMaker value lists (one number per line). Useful for AI embedding similarity: dot product after L2 normalisation = cosine similarity.

XML, XSLT, and JSON.notes: BE_XPath returns the first match; BE_XPathAll returns all matches as a value list. BE_XSLT_ApplyInMemory operates on strings; BE_XSLTApply reads/writes native file paths. BE_XMLValidate returns empty string if valid.
